name: CropSamplingLabResults
tagline: Soil, tissue, beet and grain sampling – from bag & tag to grower result cards.
description: A complete agronomy sampling app in one Power Apps code component: plan and route samples, print bag & tag labels, batch and submit to the lab with chain of custody, import lab results, compare every analyte with target ranges, review and release grower result cards and run re-samples.
features: 10 KPI tiles and lab turnaround per lab
Bag & tag IDs with Code 39 labels
Sample routes with stop order and group-by-farm
Lab batches with dispatch, due dates and overdue alerts
Paste-in lab result import with matching preview
Configurable target ranges per sample type and analyte
Grower result cards with plain-language guidance
Review with notes and acceptance for out-of-range results
Bulk collect, route, batch, review and CSV export
Undo, validation, read-only and disabled states
Phone bottom bar, tablet and desktop layouts
controlType: standard (2 controls: CropSamplingLabResults data-set + CropSamplingLabResultsPortal field)
